Total suite is now 38 tests, all pass (12.67s under pytest-xdist). Blog tab shows [blog-posts-table] with 8 seed [blog-row-*] rows. [blog-new] opens [blog-editor], filled slug/title/excerpt (category=investing default), added a paragraph block, added a list block, switched its <select> to 'list' → list-item input appeared correctly, toggled published OFF, saved → editor auto-closed and new [blog-row-<scratch>] appeared in the admin table (draft still shown in admin). critical_code_review_comments: server.py:680-684 admin_list_blog uses .to_list(500) — hard cap; fine for 8-post seed but if collection grows past 500 the admin dashboard will silently truncate. Consider pagination or removing the cap for admin-only listing.

BlogTab.jsx:391 window.confirm() is a native browser API — works but blocks JS thread and looks less polished than the rest of the admin UI which uses custom styling. Consider a custom confirm modal for consistency.

BlogTab.jsx:378 axios.get on mount does not send AbortController — if the user quickly logs out or unmounts before the response the setPosts call runs on an unmounted component (React will just warn, no bug, but eslint-warning territory).

BlogTab.jsx:451 setEditing({ ...p, read_minutes: p.readMinutes }) — the backend now returns both `read_minutes` AND `readMinutes` in the public payload (server.py:632 _blog_to_public). The frontend explicitly re-maps readMinutes→read_minutes for the editor state. On PUT the payload sends `read_minutes` which is the correct field. This works but the two-name duality is fragile — consider standardising on a single wire format (either read_minutes everywhere or readMinutes everywhere) in a follow-up.

BlogTab.jsx:196 slug field is disabled on edit (correct, matches backend PUT which doesn't accept slug in body) — good, but the disabled input still has data-testid='blog-editor-slug'; testing agents should be aware it is non-editable during edit flows.

BlogTab.jsx:170-175 the outer backdrop calls onClose() on click, and the inner SlideOver stops propagation via onClick={(e)=>e.stopPropagation()} — verified works correctly (clicks inside panel do not close). But note this means an accidental click on the dark overlay drops all unsaved edits with no confirm. A 'You have unsaved changes' guard would be a nice future improvement.

AdminPage.jsx:11 useAdminToken reads from localStorage but does not verify the token is still valid at mount — Shell will render, then any admin API call inside LeadsTab/BlogTab that returns 401 triggers onLogout. That works, but a proactive `GET /api/admin/leads` ping on mount would show the login screen faster if the token expired. Minor.

server.py:687-695 admin_create_blog echoes back the doc via _blog_to_public but sets doc['id']=str(uuid.uuid4()) then inserts — id is not part of the public payload (excluded by _blog_to_public presumably). Verify that BlogPostBase doesn't also require an id, else two ids would coexist. Current tests pass so this is fine, but noting for future refactor.
